text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov in interview to Athens daily To Vima says Macedonia's proposal for the final resolution of the name problem "helps us to preserve our dignity, and at the same time allowing the Greek government, parliament and all Greeks to say that they will not recognize a country whose name is Macedonia".

- Macedonian police captured two Albanian gun smugglers on Friday who were illegally staying in Tetovo. The weapons and ammunition were of Chinese origin aimed for the illegal arms market in Macedonia.

- Macedonian financial experts claim if the government and the International Monetary Fund agree on the denar devaluation in Macedonia, it would contribute to reviving production. If inflation were to be kept under control between five and eight percent, that could improve Macedonian production, experts say.

- Scandal in the Macedonian Lottery after police report an attempt to conceal part of the deposits while at the same time 24 lotto balls were discovered to be filled with an unknown liquid in order to make them heavier. -- Mircela Casule, Skople newsroom +389 91 201-196
